title: Microsoft Teams: intelligent recap without saving a transcript
summary: The documented controls, rollout windows and summary lifecycle are supported. The cost rating needs correction: the standard reserves Low for indirect costs only, whereas the briefing documents a required Copilot add-on licence for organisers and viewers.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: This feature generates an AI meeting summary without saving a persistent transcript or recording.
claims.quote: Organizers with a Microsoft Copilot license can generate AI summaries of Teams meetings without saving a recording or persistent transcript.

claims.claim: The release phases are General Availability and Targeted Release.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; licensing.notes; What's changing; Why it matters; rationales
claims.claim: The feature arrives automatically for Copilot-licensed users assigned a meeting policy with Copilot enabled.
claims.quote: Intelligent recap without saving transcripts is automatically available to users who have a Microsoft Copilot license and are assigned a Teams meeting policy with Copilot enabled.

claims.claim: The full intelligent recap experience includes transcription and recordings.
claims.quote: For information about the full intelligent recap experience that includes transcription and recordings, see Intelligent recap for Teams calls, meetings, and events.

claims.claim: This experience supports scheduled meetings only, not ad hoc meetings or calls.
claims.quote: Is an AI summary generated for scheduled meetings, unscheduled meetings, and calls? AI summaries are generated for scheduled meetings only.

claims.claim: Copilot-licensed organisers can enable or disable it in Meeting options before the meeting.
claims.quote: Organizers with a Copilot license can turn it on or off in Meeting options before the meeting.

claims.claim: Copilot-licensed organisers, co-organisers and presenters can turn it on or off during the meeting.
claims.quote: Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters with a Copilot license can turn it on or off during the meeting by using the meeting controls.

claims.claim: The summary is available on the Recap tab after the meeting.
claims.quote: attendees in your organization who have a Copilot license can view it on the Recap tab after the meeting.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: The roadmap says chapters, topics, mentions and audio recap may not be available.
claims.quote: After the meeting, the AI Summary will be available, but other elements of the recap may not be available (Chapters, Topics, Mentions, Audio recap).

claims.claim: The roadmap describes in-meeting enablement by organisers and eligible participants.
claims.quote: Meeting organizers can choose this setting from the meeting options before the meeting, or organizers and eligible participants can enable it during the meeting.

claims.claim: The notice's in-meeting controls paragraph says participants cannot change the setting.
claims.quote: Participants can see whether AI is being turned on/off, while participants cannot change this setting.

claims.claim: The same notice's compliance table says organisers or Copilot-licensed participants can toggle it during the meeting.
claims.quote: Meeting organizers can enable or disable the feature before the meeting, and organizers or participants with Copilot licenses can toggle it during the meeting.

claims.claim: Transcription data is temporarily held in a service-managed cache during summary generation.
claims.quote: During recap generation, transcription data is temporarily stored in a service-managed cache used by the recap service to generate the AI summary.

claims.claim: The cached transcription data is purged within one day.
claims.quote: The cached data is automatically purged within one day.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No transcript or recording is saved as part of this experience.
claims.quote: No meeting transcript or recording is saved as part of this experience.

claims.claim: The summary is a read-only Word document.
claims.quote: The AI summary is stored as a read-only Word document in the organizer's OneDrive.

claims.claim: AI summary documents support Purview eDiscovery with indexed titles, keywords and content.
claims.quote: AI summary documents support Microsoft Purview eDiscovery. The document title, keywords, and content are indexed for search.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls

claims.quote: Meeting organizers can delete the AI summary from the Recap tab or the corresponding Word document in OneDrive.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure and Security & identity; Scope
claims.claim: Viewers must be in the organiser's organisation; guests and external attendees cannot access the summary.
claims.quote: Attendees in the same organization as the meeting organizer who have a Copilot license can access the AI summary. Guests and external attendees can't access it.

claims.claim: MC1275312 was updated on 27 July 2026.
claims.quote: Updated July 27, 2026: We have updated the timeline.

claims.claim: The notice expects Targeted Release from early October to mid-October 2026.
claims.quote: Targeted Release: We will begin rolling out early October 2026 (previously mid-August) and expect to complete by mid-October 2026 (previously late August).

claims.claim: The notice expects Worldwide General Availability from mid-October to late October 2026.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out mid-October 2026 (previously late August) and expect to complete by late October 2026 (previously late September).

claims.claim: Microsoft positions this experience for organisations that restrict transcript or recording retention for compliance reasons.
claims.quote: Intelligent recap without saving transcripts provides AI-generated meeting summaries for organizations that don't allow meeting transcripts or recordings, or that need to limit transcript and recording retention for compliance reasons.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Change & support
claims.claim: Attendees without a Copilot licence cannot view this summary.
claims.quote: Attendees in the same organization as the meeting organizer who have a Copilot license can access the AI summary.

claims.claim: The feature article does not explain summary behaviour when the organiser's account is deleted before expiry.
claims.quote: Searched: "intelligent recap without saving transcripts" "organizer" "deleted". Opened the complete feature article and Memory for Microsoft Teams Meetings; only the distinct meeting-memory artifact has account-deactivation guidance.

claims.claim: The feature article does not describe how sharing restrictions, sensitivity labels or DLP apply to summary documents.
claims.quote: Searched: "intelligent recap without saving transcripts" "sensitivity" "DLP". Read the complete feature article and Enable sensitivity labels for files in SharePoint and OneDrive. The feature article covers eDiscovery and legal hold, not these controls.

claims.claim: Sensitivity-label support needs to be enabled and configured for OneDrive files.
claims.quote: Enable built-in labeling for supported Office files and PDF files in SharePoint and OneDrive so that users can apply your sensitivity labels in Office for the web.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/sensitivity-labels-sharepoint-onedrive-files to sources for the statement about enabling sensitivity labels for OneDrive files.

claims.claim: MC1275312 names the M365 Copilot (Premium) licence.
claims.quote: This feature will be available to users with an M365 Copilot (Premium) license across platforms, including desktop (Windows and Mac), web, and mobile.

claims.claim: No separate meter for this experience is documented in the feature guidance at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: intelligent recap without saving transcripts billing meter license pricing. Read the complete feature article and Copilot meeting policy guidance, plus recap licensing search excerpts. No separate meter is specified for this experience.

claims.claim: Summary expiry is configured under Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Copilot and other AI > Set a default expiration time for Intelligent Recap .docx files for non-transcribed meetings.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select an existing policy or create a new one. ... Under Copilot and other AI, next to Set a default expiration time for Intelligent Recap .docx files for non-transcribed meetings, enter the number of days that documents are retained.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays 180 sets summary expiration to 180 days.
claims.quote: The following example sets the default expiration time to 180 days. ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays 180

claims.claim: No admin UI path is documented for the intelligent recap on/off policy control.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams intelligent recap AllowIntelligentRecap Teams admin center turn off intelligent recap UI. Read the feature article and Copilot policy article; results document -AllowIntelligentRecap in PowerShell but no matching admin UI path.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false turns off intelligent recap.
claims.quote: To turn off intelligent recap, use the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet and set the -AllowIntelligentRecap parameter to $false. ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false

claims.claim: Turning off intelligent recap disables it regardless of whether transcripts are saved while leaving Copilot enabled.
claims.quote: To prevent users from using this feature while keeping Copilot enabled, turn off intelligent recap in the Teams meeting policy. ... Turning off intelligent recap disables intelligent recap for all meetings, regardless of whether transcripts are saved.

claims.claim: The Copilot setting is under Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Copilot.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select an existing policy or create a new one. ... Go to the Recording & transcription section and find the Copilot setting.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -Copilot Enabled configures the Copilot meeting policy to On.
claims.quote: On | Enabled ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Enabled

claims.claim: EnabledWithTranscript is the default Copilot meeting policy value.
claims.quote: On with saved transcript required | EnabledWithTranscript | This is the default value.

claims.claim: EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn and Disabled are additional documented -Copilot values.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Disabled

claims.claim: These are meeting policy settings applicable to users, and Copilot meeting policies can be assigned to groups or individual users.
claims.quote: You can apply your Copilot meeting policies to groups or individual users.

claims.claim: The companion meeting memory feature is in preview.
claims.quote: Meeting memory is in preview and only available to organizations in the Teams TAP program.

claims.claim: Meeting memory is available only to organisations in the Teams TAP programme.
claims.quote: Meeting memory is in preview and only available to organizations in the Teams TAP program.

claims.claim: Meeting memory files default to a five-year expiration of 1,825 days.
claims.quote: The default expiration time for memory files is five years (1,825 days), but admins can customize the expiration time as needed for their organization.

claims.claim: Administrators can customise the expiration period for meeting memory files.
claims.quote: The default expiration time for memory files is five years (1,825 days), but admins can customize the expiration time as needed for their organization.

claims.claim: Purview retention policies take precedence over the meeting memory expiration setting.
claims.quote: Purview retention policies will take precedence over the meeting memory expiration setting in the Teams Admin Center.

claims.claim: Government cloud dates are not published for this roadmap item.
claims.quote: Searched: "intelligent recap without saving transcripts" "GCC". Read roadmap 558286, MC1275312, the feature article and Copilot policy article. No government rollout dates were found for this experience; other recap GCC results concern different experiences.

claims.claim: Cost is Low, meaning indirect costs only, despite the documented Copilot add-on licence requirement.
claims.quote: Prerequisites: An add-on Microsoft Copilot license for intended users. The briefing rates cost Low; the standard defines Low as indirect cost only and Medium as add-on licences for a subset of users.
claims.fix: Change cost to medium and replace the cost rationale with: "Medium. Organisers and attendees who view the summary need a Copilot licence, documented as an add-on prerequisite. The feature guidance documents no separate meter at the time of writing (November 2026)."

claims.claim: The linked MicrosoftTeams module reference lists the command and its Identity, Copilot, AllowIntelligentRecap and IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays parameters.
claims.quote: Module: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy ... [[-Identity] <XdsIdentity>] ... [-AllowIntelligentRecap <Boolean>] ... [-Copilot <String>] ... [-IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays <Int32>]

claims.claim: The roadmap associates this item with Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365).
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Teams", "Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)"]
